span.label: Threshold comparisons between sustained and onset responders may not be valid because the spike-rate criterion may not be equally sensitive across response categories.
span.note: what this limits: threshold comparisons between response types only: CAUTION SHOULD BE USED WHEN COMPARING THRESHOLDS BETWEEN SUSTAINED AND ONSET RESPONDERS BECAUSE THE SPIKE RATE CRITERION USED TO DETERMINE RESPONSE THRESHOLD differs in effect between them
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Binaural response properties of SON neurons were not assessed, so a possible contribution of the nucleus laminaris projection remains unexplored.
span.note: what this limits: any claim about the origin of SON response properties: WE DID NOT ASSESS THE BINAURAL RESPONSE PROPERTIES OF SON NEURONS, so NL's projection remains an unexplored contribution
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In most animals only a limited region of the SON was sampled, which is why individual maps had to be combined into a standardized SON.
span.note: what this limits: the tonotopic map as a whole-nucleus claim: IN MOST SUBJECTS WE SAMPLED A LIMITED REGION OF THE SON, which is why individual maps had to be combined
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the map is explicitly less precise than in excitatory nuclei of the same species, by both error magnitude and r-squared
span.note: what this limits: any use of this map at the precision expected of excitatory nuclei: the paper states its map is the less precise of the two by both error magnitude and its own comparison
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: prediction error varies widely along the tonotopic axis rather than being uniform
span.note: what this limits: the tonotopic prediction at any single site: ERROR MAGNITUDE (|CF_predicted - CF_measured|) VARIED WIDELY AT EACH POSITION ALONG THE CALCULATED TONOTOPIC AXIS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the threshold criterion may not be equally sensitive across response categories, so between-category threshold comparisons are cautioned against
span.note: duplicate of: limitations[0] · what this limits: the same scope as item 0 - the threshold criterion may not be equally sensitive across response categories, so between-category threshold comparisons are the affected ones
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: multi-unit thresholds run higher than single-unit thresholds because sub-threshold waveforms sum
span.note: what this limits: any comparison of thresholds between recording types: THRESHOLDS OF MULTIPLE-UNIT RESPONSES TENDED TO BE SLIGHTLY HIGHER THAN THE THRESHOLDS OF ISOLATED NEURONAL RESPONSES ... THIS INCREASE REFLECTS ... WAVEFORMS THAT INDIVIDUALLY WERE NOT DETECTED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: suppressed responders were too rare to analyse spatially
